item.text: Restricting scale changes to the same action type did not recover full-rule performance. Averaging beats reassignment across whole histories, while reassignment beats averaging within action groups on AUC; Logloss favors averaging in both comparisons. That interaction weakens a simple “mixing action types causes the loss” explanation. I’ll retain the incumbent and document a bounded replication plan.
